page.overview:
Who is Fidel Camuze?

Fidel Camuze is one of the protagonists of the Star Ocean franchise, and the lead character of the series' fifth installment, Star Ocean: Integrity and Faithlessness. A 23-year-old fencing instructor from the distant planet of Faykreed IV, Fidel is thrust into adventure when he takes it upon himself to protect the young Relia.

Fidel appears in the Final Fantasy series as part of the collaboration between Final Fantasy Brave Exvius and Star Ocean -anamnesis-.

Fidel is a summonable vision and optional playable character. He is a limited-time 4-6★ Rare Summon obtainable during the raid event Vanquish Jie Revorse! (which originally ran from July 27 to August 9, 2018 in the Global version) and its rerun in January 2019.

Fidel's job is listed as Attacker and his role is Physical Damage. He has no innate element or status ailment resistances. His Trust Master is the passive ability Fortitude and Vigor, which increases the equipped unit's ATK by 40% and auto-boosts its DEF by 20% during battle.
